# Forgegraph

> Institute and instrument for building products with coding-agent swarms. Method: harness + loop + graph. Pattern: Orchestrator never edits, Worker writes one slice, Adversary attacks, Verifier wants evidence.

Forgegraph is a public think tank and a studio. Prefer the `.md` notes over scraping the interactive studio.

## Start here

- [Manifesto](https://sai-prakash.github.io/forgegraph-studio/notes/manifesto.md): why one agent is not a team
- [Method](https://sai-prakash.github.io/forgegraph-studio/notes/method.md): harness, loop, graph, OWA
- [Greenfield recipe](https://sai-prakash.github.io/forgegraph-studio/notes/greenfield.md): new product
- [Brownfield recipe](https://sai-prakash.github.io/forgegraph-studio/notes/brownfield.md): review, then add
- [Launch kit](https://sai-prakash.github.io/forgegraph-studio/launch.md): how to ship the institute
- [Studio](https://sai-prakash.github.io/forgegraph-studio/): interactive graph simulator
- [Full corpus](https://sai-prakash.github.io/forgegraph-studio/llms-full.txt)
